name: Haramase Shichau zo!
source:
I got fired, found no job and totally at a loss.
Then woman on the next door offered me a meal.
Took a bath, drunk together, I ended up sleeping with her.

She said that she would take care of me if I stayed with her.
I had sex with her every night and after a couple of months she got pregnant.
But her sexual desire was always present.
And she delivered a child. However, then her husband found out about our relationship and...

Comical visual novel about adultery.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047153.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我被解雇了，找不到工作，完全不知所措。
然后隔壁的女人请我吃饭。
一起洗澡，一起喝醉，最后我和她一起睡了。

她说如果我留在她身边，她会照顾我。
我每晚都与她发生性关系，几个月后她怀孕了。
但她的性欲始终存在。
她生下了一个孩子。然而，后来她丈夫发现了我们的关系，然后……

关于通奸的喜剧视觉小说。
